candidates.excerpt: The Maharashtra Congress held protests across the state over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. The party accused the Election Commission of favouring the BJP, sought action against CEC Gyanesh Kumar and submitted memoranda to officials

candidates.title: States Told To Plan Rabi Crops Around Water Availability
candidates.excerpt: Agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan urged states to assess water availability and soil moisture before finalising rabi crop plans.

candidates.title: How Matt Damon’s 2006 Zambia trip inspired a water nonprofit now reaching 92 million people
candidates.excerpt: Matt Damon launched his water mission in 2006, founding H2O Africa Foundation to support safe-water initiatives. This evolved into Water.org, reaching over 92 million people through a financing model, transforming the global approach to the water crisis from charity to sustainable solutions.
